_how: How often each website gets new stories. every_days = days between new stories, per_run = how many stories each time it is due. Edit freely; the daily scheduled task reads this file. Keys are site keys from stories/data.js, or a group: 'colleges' or 'clubs' apply to every college or club (each one is checked on its own, so they stay staggered).

times.why: Daily newspaper: new stories every day

uninews.why: Campus paper: a couple of times a week

larssen.why: Boat builder: new products, class rule changes, like West Coast Sailing's news

colleges.why: Each college: about every week and a half

clubs.why: Each club or sailing center: every two weeks

sbx.why: SBX Airport: new routes, holiday travel, construction, parking

nesf.why: Northeastern Sailing Foundation: grants, training, programs

ayrc.why: AYRC: weekly in season (results, previews), registration news in the off-season
